fields.label: Word or phrase
fields.description: The word or phrase for players to type

fields.label: Fillable item
fields.description: The items that fill up as students type correct letters.

fields.label: Fillable item capacity
fields.description: Number of correct letters/characters that fill one fillable item.

fields.label: Treat fixed typos as accurate
fields.description: When checked, typos that players fix will not count against their accuracy.

fields.label: Show virtual keyboard
fields.description: Show a virtual keyboard on the screen with the current key highlighted.

fields.label: Force players to correct typos
fields.description: When checked, players cannot continue to type after a typo until they fix it.

fields.label: Use sound
fields.description: Enable sound effects (click for each letter and ding for each filled item)

fields.label: Time limit (seconds)
fields.description: Game time limit in seconds. Set to 0 for unlimited time.

fields.label: Show timer
fields.description: Show the game timer on screen. When hidden, the game will still end at the time limit (unless set to unlimited).

fields.label: Show play again
fields.description: Show a 'Play again' button after the game ends.
